utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll check the fence and lamp post when I get there, and I can help with tools or carrying supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — that’s a big help. I’ll let the neighbors know to bring their items to the community center on Sunday, and I’ll keep an eye out for any extra tools or volunteers we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — I’ll send over the repair drive details so you can share them around. Thanks for helping get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll include the collection times and send everything over to you soon. Thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I’ll do my best to make it around 4 if I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn—could you tell me the exact location and start time for the repair drive? I want to make sure everyone knows where to go.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — it’s at the neighborhood center on Maple Street, and we’re starting at 10 a.m. I’ll be there to point everyone in the right direction!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks — I’ll wait for your update and be ready to help once you confirm the hours and Saturday sorting.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Hana
